items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And one day he came by the house, and asked my mother if I could join the St. Agnes Band as a drummer, so here I was, 11 years old, playing in the St. Agnes Marching Band.

ctx.x: Yeah. See, while I was playing with the UNIA band, most of the large churches had their own marching bands, like St. Agnes Church, which was one of the biggest Episcopal churches in Miami for black people, they had their own band -- the St. Agnes Cornet Band, and the guy that was the leader of that band was a guy from Nassau by the name of Roberts, but everybody called him Bella Roberts -- he was a great trumpet player.
And one day he came by the house, and asked my mother if I could join the St. Agnes Band as a drummer, so here I was, 11 years old, playing in the St. Agnes Marching Band.
That's interesting. So did you finally join the St. Agnes Church, for religion? What was your religion?
